avis.texte: Love this serum! On hot summer days, I dont need extra moisturizer because this serum is very hydrating. I also use under my eyes and concealer lays better. A must try!
40 year old and constantly being told my skin is fabulous and i look much younger. Def helped with lines around my mouth and crows feet. Use daily!!!

Thos absolutely changed my sensitive dry skin. I was starting to notice that my smile lines were getting more prominent. After adding this product the lines have bounced back to how they used to look. I'm on my second bottle. Game changer!

I unfortunately broke out from this product. I really wanted to like this product and tried again with it to just keep breaking out. I do have their collagen facial spray and that is great and doesnt cause breakouts for me!

I've been using this serum for a little over a month now, and I will be repurchasing. This stuff heals your skin barrier and any acne or blemishes you may have! I rarely get acne but when i do get a little smudge, by the next day I already notice it going away! And by day two it's basically gone! Also, this stuff makes your skin glow! My skin has never looked so hydrated and glowy before! So yes, I 1,000% recommend this with anyone who has dry dehydrated skin.

My fine lines and deep wrinkles are disappearing right before my eyes! Pumps out deep wrinkles. I just started using the Deep Collagen Retinol Power Boosting Capsule Cream. Really enjoy how both products work together.
This serum goes on the skin beautifully and it layers well on top on my essences.

This is my favorite hidden gem of a skincare product. I use it in the morning after my vitamin C serum. I have oily/combo acne prone skin and this doesn't break me out. My skin looks more even, soothed, hydrated, and glowing. I have received compliments on my skin. I work at Ulta and recommend it to everyone!
I really wanted to love this product. But it made me break out. I am going to try using it only once a day and see if that helps.

We all know that Korean products are fabulous. I have been using them for years. I ran across this brand by accident and I have to tell you I use everything in the line and I absolutely love it. I get compliments on my skin every day. I am often told I do not look my age nor anywhere near it. I attribute it to these products and would definitely recommend them.

I am a 54 year old with past sun damage. I also have VERY sensitive skin and every time I have tried something to help my skin, I would break out or have a skin reaction. I decided a few months ago that I needed to spend more time reading about K beauty products and this product continually popped up in different forums as highly effective. Since it wasn't expensive, I decided to try it. I honestly have no words for what this has done to my skin. I agree with a previous reviewer where she said that this is "magical." This is how I would describe it. I have not had skin like this in years. I have had a SIGNIFICANT reduction in fine lines and wrinkles, a daily healthy glow, and improvements in firmness. As an added bonus, it has been an incredible primer for my makeup. The amount of compliments I have received on my skin has blown me away. But most importantly, I feel so much better about how I look as I go through hormonal changes. In case anyone is wondering, I have not added any other new products to my regiment. I was only using Clinique Moisture Surge prior to this (again- my skin is so sensitive that this was about all I could handle). So the Collagen serum was the only addition so this is how I know how effective this product is! It also feels soooo good on the skin. It is important that you shake the bottle before you use the dripper so the ingredients can mix. At this price point and Ulta's excellent return policy, this should be a no brainer for you to try. avis.texte: The product arrived about a quarter empty, so my first impression wasn't great. Despite that, I liked it enough not to complain. Unfortunately, I kept having issues with the bottle leaking during travel, which meant I never got to use the entire product. What I did use, though, I really loved! I'd like to buy it again, but I won't be able to travel with it, and I'm still worried it might arrive partially empty again. it is on the cheaper end of skin care so at least I didn't feel like I wasted a ton of money.

I've been using for the two weeks and this week I've received compliments of people telling me my skin is glowy and beautiful. I will buy again.

I have used a lot of skin care in my time. Having worked in skin care most of my life, I am not a paid spokes person nor did I receive this product for free. It was recommended to me so I decided to try it. I have not found anything that can manage my combination skin. This is absolutely fabulous and everything else in this line is amazing. I would highly recommend it especially if you are over 50.
This left my skin so hydrated and smooth. I definitely will be purchasing again.
Just finished my full bottle and it made my skin sooooo soft. Literally couldn't believe how soft my skin felt the first time I used it. Definitely repurchasing!

Left my face feeling tacky and even after two weeks no visible difference.
Ive been using this product for 2 weeks now and my skin is dry & senstive. It has been so lightweight yet effective on my skin. My skin is so glowy & moisturized without feelinf greasy.

This stuff is magical. I have been using this every morning and night for a couple of weeks now and I've noticed my forehead lines that were forming have disappeared. I think I've finally found something to renew my skin and help it look healthy again.

I use this serum to prep my undereyes and lips in the morning and I look so refreshed almost instantly after. Idk what is in this serum, but it gives a plumping effect to my lips without the burn of a typical plumper. Not sure if this is the conventional way of using this product, but def a cool beauty hack!!! This, the Power Boosting Pads, and Collagen Mist are an insane trio - WHEWWW absolute fave brand

I'm absolutely in love with this serum. The instant hydration and suppleness is insane. I've noticed drastic differences over the past 2 months with my hollow undereyes and my fine lines. This will always be in my skincare routine. So happy to have found this brand!! Nothing beats kbeauty.
